trust_decision.summary: Whether an admin-supplied media file name may be stored in the public media filesystem with a server-executable extension; decided only in FileHandler::getFilePath, by a case-sensitive regex over a two-item default blacklist, applied before the extension is lowercased.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'MediaBundle extension blacklist bypass'. The only blacklist use is this preg_replace, and the lowercasing two lines later sits right next to it.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP admin media create/drop/modal-create/bulk-upload/edit routes (src/Kunstmaan/MediaBundle/Controller/MediaController.php:44,126,314,350,427) via Doctrine prePersist/postPersist -> FileHandler::prepareMedia/saveMedia; public API MediaCreatorService::createFile
bundle config kunstmaan_media.blacklisted_extensions default / new allowed_extensions
service wiring for the image and file handlers (ImageHandler extends FileHandler)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Kunstmaan/MediaBundle/DependencyInjection/Configuration.php:34-35 (default list was only php/htaccess; fix.diff:113-119 expands it to phtml/phar/php5/... )

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about case: a solver who lowercases before matching can argue the default list is a project config choice that users override, and that .phtml/.phar/.php5 are a different issue. Both rename routes are a CLI maintenance command or a soft-delete restore hook, not an upload, and they only reuse a name that was 'already stored'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate media must keep their real extension with uppercase input lowercased (holiday.JPG -> holiday.jpg, report.pdf, files with no extension -> no extension). svg/html must stay uploadable by default. Bulk upload must keep working. An over-broad allow-list, or turning everything into .txt, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: mixed-case extension (shell.pHp) via UploadedFile client name, which keeps the raw extension case (src/Kunstmaan/MediaBundle/Helper/File/FileHandler.php:175)
alternate executable extensions missing from the default list (phtml, php5, phar, phps, shtml, cgi, asp, jsp ...)
case-differing entries in the configured blacklist/allow-list themselves (array_map strtolower, fix.diff:217,225)
allow-list configured together with a blacklisted extension (blacklist wins, fix.diff:386-391)
double extension evil.php.jpg (slugifier collapses inner dot, fix.diff:348-350)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: kuma:media:rename-soft-deleted --original renames the stored file to Media::originalFilename verbatim, with no blacklist, lowercasing or slugify.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: An operator-run CLI maintenance command for soft-deleted media; it is not an upload path and only restores a name already in the database.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other directory (Command/) in the same bundle; nothing in the report leads there

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Restoring a soft-deleted media item (DoctrineMediaListener preUpdate) builds the new key as originalFilename + '.' + the old extension and renames the file there, bypassing getFilePath.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The trailing extension is the already-sanitised stored one (.txt), so it looks safe. The leftover inner '.php' segment (shell.php.txt) only matters for multi-extension handler configs, a neighbouring concern.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: EventListener/ directory, Doctrine lifecycle hook; the rename happens at src/Kunstmaan/MediaBundle/EventListener/DoctrineMediaListener.php:101-110

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The edit form maps an originalFilename field that is only HTML-readonly, so a submitted value is persisted unsanitised and feeds both rename routes above.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The field is 'readonly' and on edit no file is written (saveMedia returns unless content is a File, src/Kunstmaan/MediaBundle/Helper/File/FileHandler.php:221-223).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A createFile variant that writes the file through the Gaufrette filesystem under its own key instead of FileHandler::getFilePath.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A service-level import helper that 'keeps the original name' is a common maintainer shortcut.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: getMediaFromUrl naming the stored file after the URL path extension directly.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The remote-URL import already derives the filename from the effective URL at line 155-157.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An ImageHandler override of the storage key, for example for converted/webp originals, that skips the parent's extension check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ImageHandler already overrides prepareMedia and is a second service wired with the same blacklist (handlers.yml:23-32).

O9_family: CWE-434 unrestricted upload of dangerous file type (denylist case/normalisation mismatch, incomplete default denylist)

O10_build.project_tests: src/Kunstmaan/MediaBundle/Tests/Helper/File/FileHandlerTest.php (uses Gaufrette Local adapter, no DB), src/Kunstmaan/MediaBundle/Tests/DependencyInjection/ConfigurationTest.php, KunstmaanMediaExtensionTest.php

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the /i flag to the preg_replace in getFilePath (or lowercase first), leaving the two-item default list and the rename routes untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: FormBundle has its own, separate upload extension allow-list for form submissions (src/Kunstmaan/FormBundle/Entity/FormSubmissionFieldTypes/FileFormSubmissionField.php:111); it is a different sink and advisory.
Media::originalFilename persisted from the edit form can contain '/' and reach the rename routes, which is a possible path-traversal; not pursued.
svg/html stay allowed by default (stored XSS), as the fix notes; not this advisory.
unverified: Whether the latest release still has the rename routes: no latest code was provided (present_in_latest unknown).
Whether Symfony form handling actually binds the readonly originalFilename on edit was inferred from the mapped TextType field, not run.
The O1 count of 6 (5 HTTP routes + MediaCreatorService API) assumes edit with a new file reaches prepareMedia via Doctrine preUpdate; not traced end to end.
FixturesBundle MediaBuilder (src/Kunstmaan/FixturesBundle/Builder/MediaBuilder.php:71-80) is an extra API route into the same handler; not counted.
